_note: 取代 v2／v3 的全域 GLOW 句。每一句都翻自該人設 character.md 的『後製』欄，所以 16 位的膚質與影調處理各不相同 —— 這是使用者指出同質性問題後最關鍵的一項改動。
wendy-yeo: Low-light, high-contrast finish with the shadows left in: her face may sit half in light and half in shadow, while her hands and anything glass or liquid stay sharp.
zhiyi-shen: A single warm light source on her with the rest of the frame dropping away — the deliberately warm, soft-shadowed treatment she uses for anything shot at home, not the cold high-contrast look of her office pictures.
angel-chiu: Real skin texture, not smoothed: pores, a little unevenness and the tiredness around her eyes are all left in, and the warm light keeps its grain and its shadows.
emma-kao: A single light source and deliberately off-centre framing, the opposite of the clean symmetrical look she is shot with at work; skin kept real rather than polished.
cheryl-soh: Clean, high-quality rendering with fair cool-toned skin, the warm lamp-lit treatment she uses for rooms rather than the cold treatment of her working pictures.
peggy-lee: High-contrast, metallic finish: reflections and wet ground are kept, and her skin stays fair rather than going yellow under the night lighting.
wanyin-jiang: Low saturation, soft light and a lot of empty space in the frame; skin kept real, with none of the plastic smoothing of a fake-vintage filter.
jia-seo: A single warm light source with a shallow depth of field, the treatment she uses for anything shot after hours rather than the crisp high-clarity look of her dance footage.
somi-oh: Low, warm light with the saturation kept up; skin kept real and a little shiny rather than matte and retouched.
yerin-han: Bright and clear, but with any suntan actively suppressed — her skin stays cool and pale, the way someone who reapplies sunscreen every two hours actually looks.
angeline-kwee: Natural light in warm-neutral tones with her skin kept fair and cool — deliberately avoiding both a tanned look and the blown-out brightness of holiday photographs.
miu-shiraishi: Warm wood tones under window light, with steam and dust left visible in the air and nothing over-sharpened.
ruoruo-tang: Soft side light and low contrast with real skin texture: the shadows are what define the lines of her body, with no highlights keyed up to fake them.
sydney-leong: Warm natural light with the heat left in the picture — the moving shadow of a fan across her, and skin that is real rather than smoothed.
tammy-chou: Bright and saturated and not deliberately polished: the lighting is flat and strong, and clutter in the frame is left in because that is where the realism comes from.
zoey-yeh: Natural light only, with overexposure and soft focus allowed: low contrast, visible grain, and her skin left completely unretouched — no smoothing and no evening out of tone.
